question: During caesarean section, the assistant applying fundal pressure while the surgeon delivers the fetal head through the uterine incision is a recognised and recommended technique to facilitate delivery.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Fundal pressure applied by the assistant is indeed a standard part of caesarean section technique, particularly for delivery of a deeply engaged fetal head. It mirrors the principle of uterine fundal expression during vaginal delivery.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Controlled fundal pressure by the assistant is a standard technique used to assist delivery of the fetal head through the lower-segment incision, particularly when the head is deeply engaged or impacted in the pelvis.
